verses.text: Joshua had gotten old and had years on him. Yahweh told him, ‘You’re older now, but there’s still a lot of land left to take possession of. 🗺️
‘Here’s the land still on the list: all the Philistine regions and all the Geshurite territory, 📜
‘from the Shihor River by Egypt north to Ekron’s border, counted as Canaanite land—the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, plus the Avvim. 🗺️
‘To the south: all Canaanite land, Mearah belonging to the Sidonians, as far as Aphek and the Amorite border. 🏞️
‘Then the Gebalite land and all Lebanon eastward, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath. 🏔️
‘The hill-country people from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim—all the Sidonians too. I’ll drive them out ahead of Israel. Just allot the land to Israel as its inheritance, the way I commanded you. 🛡️
‘Now divide this land as an inheritance for the nine tribes and half of Manasseh.’ 👥
Moses had already given land east of the Jordan to the Reubenites and Gadites—the land Moses, Yahweh’s servant, assigned them: 📜
from Aroer at the edge of the Arnon Valley, including the town in the middle of the valley, and all the Medeba plain up to Dibon; 🗺️
all Sihon’s towns too. He was the Amorite king who ruled from Heshbon, up to the Ammonite border; 👑
also Gilead, the Geshurite and Maacathite borders, all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah; 🏔️
plus Og’s whole kingdom in Bashan. He ruled from Ashtaroth and Edrei and was one of the last Rephaim. Moses attacked them and drove them out. ⚔️
But Israel never drove out the Geshurites or Maacathites. Geshur and Maacath still live among Israel to this day. 🏘️
The tribe of Levi got no land inheritance. Their inheritance was the offerings made by fire to Yahweh, Israel’s God, just as he had told them. 🛐
Moses allotted land to Reuben’s tribe, by their families. 📜
Their border ran from Aroer at the edge of the Arnon Valley, including the town in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba; 🗺️
Heshbon and all its towns on the plain, including Dibon, Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon; 🏘️
Jahaz, Kedemoth, and Mephaath; 🏘️
Kiriathaim, Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar on the hill above the valley; 🏘️
Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth; 🏘️

all the towns on the plain and all Sihon’s kingdom, the Amorite king who ruled Heshbon. Moses struck him along with Midian’s chiefs—Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, Sihon’s princes who lived in that land. ⚔️
Israel also killed Balaam son of Beor, the fortune-teller, with the sword, along with the rest of the dead. ⚔️
Reuben’s border ran along the Jordan River. That was the inheritance for Reuben’s families, with its towns and villages. 🌊
Moses allotted land to Gad’s tribe, to the Gadites by their families. 📜
Their border included Jazer, all the towns of Gilead, and half of Ammon’s land up to Aroer near Rabbah; 🗺️
from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir; 🏘️
and in the valley: Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon—the rest of Sihon’s kingdom from Heshbon, along the Jordan bank, to the far edge of the Sea of Chinnereth east of the Jordan. 🌊
That was Gad’s inheritance, by family, with its towns and villages. 🏘️
Moses also allotted land to half the tribe of Manasseh, by its families. 📜
Their border ran from Mahanaim across all Bashan—all Og’s kingdom in Bashan—and all the villages of Jair there: sixty towns. 🗺️
Half of Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei—the towns in Og’s kingdom of Bashan—went to Machir son of Manasseh and half of Machir’s families. 🏘️
These are the inheritances Moses distributed in Moab’s plains, east of the Jordan near Jericho. 📜
But Moses gave no land inheritance to Levi’s tribe. Yahweh, Israel’s God, was their inheritance, just as he had told them. 🛐
